title: UTSA NLP at SemEval-2022 Task 4: An Exploration of Simple Ensembles of Transformers, Convolutional, and Recurrent Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of deep learning models and ensembles to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) for a competition task.
